decisions.designed_value: 只消耗指定喜愛食物；不需購買或消耗通用捕獲項圈，沒有固定HP<=20%硬門檻。成功後的唯一項圈是持久化個體憑證。

decisions.name_zh: 召喚與寵物共用容量
decisions.acceptance: 混合滿容量、替換、取消及死亡後容量逐一測試。
decisions.designed_value: 捕捉寵物、一般召喚、迷魅生物、造屍與元素精靈共用本列CHA總容量，每個個體占1格；一般召喚另外最多3隻。臨時召喚不消耗食物、不獲寵物EXP或成長，死亡不掉物、不產生項圈；擊殺EXP歸主人。重複召喚／替換先校驗容量再原子提交，不暫時超額。
decisions.reason: 跨系統一致性補值，不改動使用者指定的每6CHA及妖精+2。

runtime_supplements.reason: The approved table has no collision masks.
runtime_supplements.decision: Deterministic connected logical geometry from each listed seed, dimensions, corridor width and walkable target; anchor tree and retreat loop, seeded coherent frontier growth. Not exact official terrain; original art is independently required.

runtime_supplements.reason: No starting inventory/economy specified.
runtime_supplements.decision: Talking Island village; 300 adena, 20 red potions, 5 meat, 1 return scroll. Knight short sword/leather armor; Elf bow/leather armor/200 arrows; Mage staff/robe; Dark Elf dark dual blades/leather armor. All +0 identified uncursed. No learned skills, books or pets.

runtime_supplements.reason: No machine-readable underwater flags.
runtime_supplements.decision: EVA floors 2–3 are underwater; floor 1 is preparation. Without breathing effect, every 5 seconds lose max(1,floor(maxHP*0.05)).

runtime_supplements.reason: Island return prohibition exists only in prose.
runtime_supplements.decision: Forgotten Island and Moon Island disallow voluntary random teleport/return. Paid boat passage remains required; death follows normal loss/home recovery rules.

runtime_supplements.reason: Zone bindings permit every ordinary species in all bands but do not define locality.
runtime_supplements.decision: Ordinary spawn slots are ordered by fixed catalog monster level and ID and allocated by the declared zone shares. Tameable species use separate habitat allocation excluding the first patrol zone when multiple zones exist. No player-dependent filtering or stat adjustment. Exact positions remain seeded within allowed rectangles; bosses keep specified anchors.

runtime_supplements.reason: Movement scheduler and obstacle pursuit need concrete semantics.
runtime_supplements.decision: Player base walking interval is 400ms; attacks require line of sight, and blocked ranged attacks pursue a legal closer location. Eight-way movement forbids diagonal corner cutting. Geometric masks are original, not official-map replicas.

runtime_supplements.reason: Elemental level/movement and counterbarrier maximum were underspecified.
runtime_supplements.decision: Elemental summons inherit caster level, move every600ms, use catalog attack timing/damage as magical elemental damage without ongoing MP spending. Counterbarrier uses maximum weapon small-target dice plus enchantment, with a one-second retaliation gate.

runtime_supplements.reason: Execution ordering requires explicit decisions.
runtime_supplements.decision: Interruptions do not refund spent casting resources. Lost or invalid targets produce no effect. Periodic effects first tick after their interval. Haste and bravery aliases do not multiply twice. Self effects always target the caster. Charm retains injured current HP.

runtime_supplements.reason: Catalog lacks concrete sensing and every ability geometry.
runtime_supplements.decision: Hostile acquisition radius8cells, species assistance and catalog leash are used. Ground hazards, bolt/root/poison/burst/cone/enrage are explicit runtime adapters. Geometry/cooldowns beyond provided fields are original implementation values, not verified Classic mechanics.

runtime_supplements.reason: Weapon-break and potion-block require actual monster-side state.
runtime_supplements.decision: Orc, orc archer/fighter, skeleton/archer and black knight have breakable weapon durability100; zero halves physical damage. Orc fighter and black knight carry one red potion per spawn and use it below30%HP unless potion-blocked. These selections are independent design.

runtime_supplements.reason: Production table names crafting services without full recipes.
runtime_supplements.decision: Lada:12leather+200adena→leather armor. Julie:15leather+5iron+800→elven bow. Vincent:15iron+500→broad sword. Moria mage-only:12leather+1sapphire+800→mage robe. These four recipes are independent design.

runtime_supplements.reason: Totem service requires a concrete repeatable exchange.
runtime_supplements.decision: Elf Warden exchanges10identical listed tribal totems for250adena and0XP. This is one supplemental exchange in addition to55baseline quests, not an official quest restoration.

runtime_supplements.reason: Underwater consumable procurement absent.
runtime_supplements.decision: Heine supply sells EVA blessing for300 and mermaid scale for120; reference buyback prices75/30. No automatic sale. These prices are independent design.

runtime_supplements.reason: Automatic settings require starting defaults.
runtime_supplements.decision: Defaults: red potion below35%HP, blue potion threshold25%MP, target10red/minimum1, return at80%weight, automatic food and storage disabled, no automatic skill priority until configured. Gold or capacity preventing minimum stock produces an explicit town stop. Home is changed only through explicit NPC action.

runtime_supplements.reason: Passive offline behavior and exact chronological resolution required.
runtime_supplements.decision: No elapsed-time cap. Auto-disabled offline cancels manual movement/target/cast; passive clocks continue, enemy damage-over-time cannot produce offline kills. Active automatic hunting uses identical event rules online/offline. Millisecond fractions persist; queues, reserved fusion outcome and checkpoints are saved transactionally.

runtime_supplements.reason: Quest prose must become a deterministic sequence.
runtime_supplements.decision: Each listed step advances in order; future objective progress is not banked. Turn-in rechecks class, level and prerequisites. Fifty-five quest texts/objectives are baseline original designs, not official quest content.

runtime_supplements.reason: Transformation presentation needs bounded forms.
runtime_supplements.decision: Polymorph self selections are skeletonLv15, black knightLv30, KurtzLv45 and death knightLv50; no added stat bonuses. Enemy sheep form retains the specific spell damage penalty. Missing art remains visible in coverage tracking.

runtime_supplements.reason: The original ten-cell route network produced nearly empty mobile views.
runtime_supplements.decision: Logical corridors capped at five cells, preserving connected retreat routes and minimum clearance. Seeded irregular solid masses beside encounter clearings support collision-aligned trees/rocks; target walkable totals and anchor reachability retained. This revises original generated geometry, not official layouts.

runtime_supplements.reason: Lighting spell radius exists but base dungeon visibility is unspecified.
runtime_supplements.decision: Dungeon visual light radius defaults to6logical cells; Light extends it to8. Blindness uses its catalog2-cell vision for rendering and target/ranged limits. Outdoor daytime remains naturally lit. No day/night progression speed multiplier.

runtime_supplements.reason: A ranged automatic character could otherwise remain targeting without ammunition.
runtime_supplements.decision: When arrows run out, return to town. Replenish if an arrow target stock is configured; otherwise stop with an explicit configuration message. No free arrows or automatic choice of stock quantity.

runtime_supplements.reason: Controlled destination and companion placement require exact adapter behavior.
runtime_supplements.decision: Memory destinations belong to the current map. Ordinary random/controlled teleport moves the caster; group teleport moves owned active companions initially within2cells to distinct nearby legal cells. Cross-map world-tree travel follows normal companion travel.

runtime_supplements.reason: Configured skill priorities require resource-aware targeting.
runtime_supplements.decision: Only explicitly configured automatic skills run. Ally restoration targets the hero; skip restoration at full relevant resource. Self buffs refresh only when absent or within min(3 seconds,10% of duration) of expiry. No starting or default automatic skills.

runtime_supplements.reason: Imported progress must retain eligible offline time without merging inventories.
runtime_supplements.decision: Confirmed import replaces the current adventure and then resolves its saved timestamp once. A future imported timestamp is visibly clamped to the current time without granting credit. A native future timestamp blocks for recovery. Checksums detect corruption, not authentication or tamper-proofing.

runtime_supplements.reason: Unlimited elapsed time must not create unbounded journal storage or UI message queues.
runtime_supplements.decision: Simulation chunks adapt from1 second according to CPU time, never capping eligible elapsed duration. A worker waits for durable-save acknowledgement before sending another checkpoint; pause waits for the outstanding save. Checkpoint journal uses512 rotating records with real revision numbers. Current save, last-known-good and explicit archives are separate.

runtime_supplements.reason: Original period-appropriate audio is needed without copied recordings.
runtime_supplements.decision: Three newly composed 32/32/24-bar region scores use bounded WebAudio harp/flute/string/bell synthesis with seven event cues. Sound begins disabled and requires a gesture. Background audio stops; stale effects are discarded. Music is original, not official Lineage audio.

runtime_supplements.reason: Official tile masks and building footprints are unavailable.
runtime_supplements.decision: Starter-town market uses an authored clear service court and six original raster buildings. Foundation polygons measured from pixels determine blocked cells; door approaches and existing NPC/landmark/connection tiles remain accessible. Old internal v3 positions newly inside buildings relocate to nearest legal tile with a preserved archived snapshot and visible notice; currency, items, RNG and elapsed time do not change. Measured polygon movement edges also block thin-wall crossings and line of sight. Only exterior door/approach actors draw above their own closed building; gate aperture uses normal depth.

runtime_supplements.reason: The requested two-cell wolf leap lacks an exact contact trajectory definition.
runtime_supplements.decision: A 250ms visual contact-and-return lunge follows an already validated line-of-sight attack. Logical position, damage and RNG occur once under the existing combat rules; the leap sprite follows the target contact point and returns without a second hit, even if the target dies.

runtime_supplements.reason: Overlapping projected sprites and labels can obscure the mobile hero.
runtime_supplements.decision: Selected enemy name and HP remain grouped and stack above the hero label with viewport clamping. Only a foreground actor whose opaque pixels cover all sampled hero head/torso points fades smoothly to 65%; logical depth, size, targeting and coordinates remain unchanged.

runtime_supplements.reason: Current navigation validates terrain and diagonal corners only.
runtime_supplements.decision: Moving actor and NPC occupancy blocking is not implemented. Terrain pathfinding must not be described as complete actor collision.

runtime_supplements.reason: Catalog art dependency arrays do not define runtime effect phases.
runtime_supplements.decision: Initial verified bindings are consumed-ammunition arrow flight, actual physical contact, single-target fire-bolt flight, and actual skill HP restoration. Effects are bounded presentation events; combat damage/resources still resolve under the existing engine schedule. No generic fire/heal art is assigned to unrelated buffs, area spells, poison or control effects. Additional families need explicit phase integration.

runtime_supplements.reason: No official tile masks are supplied; outdoor-shaped collision produced fragmented masonry walls.
runtime_supplements.decision: 32 crypt/tower maps use deterministic orthogonal rooms and corridors informed by the five approved layout archetypes. All catalog endpoints, landmarks, encounter areas and routes remain reachable. These are original playable layouts, not reconstructed official floor plans. Layout revision4 archives old snapshots and relocates positions newly blocked by the updated masks, including monster origins and teleport memories.

runtime_supplements.reason: Regional roofs and tree trunks hid adjacent service figures despite nonoverlapping foundations.
runtime_supplements.decision: Elf smith moves from55,44 to56,51 with its building; Oren keeper64,44 to67,50 with its building; Aden healer73,44 to72,45 with its building. IDs, services and quest references remain unchanged. Giran stall and exact gate support navigation corrections are recorded separately in art/world metadata.

runtime_supplements.reason: Catalog specifies a cone but no exact angular mask.
runtime_supplements.decision: Dragon breath uses a90degree fan with Chebyshev range and terrain line of sight, affecting the player and active owned pets/summons inside it. The approved low-HP attack-speed multiplier applies to the actual attack interval at the stated threshold. Presentation does not create extra damage.

runtime_supplements.reason: Measured stair/cave supports cut off small original floor pockets; one revised room lacked two exterior approach cells.
runtime_supplements.decision: 136 portal structures use unchanged canonical endpoints and measured support tiles/edges. Explicit minimal landing/side-route cells on nine maps reconnect floor and approaches, without changing topology or rates. Exact cells and sources are recorded in art/world/portal-landing-refinements.json. Revision5 safely archives and relocates positions newly occupied by supports. Activation effects are disabled and no fast travel is added.

runtime_supplements.reason: Original FX clips require outcome-specific placement; source catalog dependencies are not event mappings.
runtime_supplements.decision: 25 damage skills have explicit visual bindings; successful status applications, actual healing, capture, revival, fusion, potion use, summons, teleport arrival, pickup and level increases emit transient effects. Monster spell cues and elemental attacks use their actual outcomes. Measured beam emitters align to projected targets without changing damage timing or range. Existing fire-wall cells use a dedicated flame loop; other wall/trap cells show repeating ground pulses only during their real lifetime. Neither adds collision or damage. Four elemental breath materials are separately authored; projected cone presentation is detailed in IMPL-BREATH-PRESENTATION-001.

runtime_supplements.reason: The approved pet modes require distinct attack, follow, stay and defend controls, but do not fully specify defend target selection.
runtime_supplements.decision: Defend retaliates only against a currently engaged monster that last inflicted positive damage on the owner or this pet. Mode changes clear stale movement and targets. Hunger prevents attack/regen but preserves Stay. The catalog exceptions for pets above owner level or above capacity force Follow and reject contradictory commands explicitly. No mode change consumes RNG.

runtime_supplements.reason: Directional original material clips must represent the already implemented90-degree Chebyshev breath fan instead of a narrow stretched beam.
runtime_supplements.decision: Fire, water, wind and earth use separately authored original material sequences. The source axes project into the existing fan range; a soft-edge mask and material-specific opacity (water38%,earth58%,wind48%,fire55%) preserve terrain visibility. This presentation does not alter cone damage, range, LOS, RNG or timing. Lightning remains a narrow fixed-width beam. Actual dragon-mouth attachment awaits each original body integration.

runtime_supplements.reason: The approved Cat/Rabbit amounts and cooldowns require explicit runtime action scheduling and eligibility.
runtime_supplements.decision: Catalog Cat healing, Rabbit fire damage and8-second MP recovery are implemented without universal HP regeneration. Utility healing works in Follow/Stay while fed and eligible; hungry/overlevel/overcapacity or spell-disabled pets do not cast. Spell actions postpone the next normal attack by one ordinary attack interval; Rabbit holds its magic range while mana is available and otherwise approaches for normal melee. MP clocks reset on capture, activation and resurrection. Pet passive clocks continue while the owner awaits revival. Successful harmful statuses provoke normal retaliation using the existing assist radius; resisted status applications do not. Direct owned-player/pet/summon magical damage uses the same retaliation as physical damage. Stored or dead pets receive no periodic healing/damage; effect durations still expire. Activation/revival restart food and MP clocks, and move any overdue effect tick to the first future point on its original periodic phase, without retroactive ticks. Owner level increases release existing banked XP for every owned pet, including stored/dead individuals, without healing or revival.

runtime_supplements.reason: A single humanoid-height projectile origin floated above small pets; persistent fire hazards needed a distinct non-impact animation.
runtime_supplements.decision: Actor-tagged projectiles interpolate between source/target torso heights at42% of displayed body height; head effects use97%, while ground rings remain on the feet. Exact dragon-mouth sockets remain pending original-body integration. Existing fire-wall cells render a72px eight-frame720ms flame loop with83ms stagger per cell; all lifetime/damage/LOS stay engine-owned. Other ground hazards retain their own visual pulses.

runtime_supplements.reason: Equipment identification/curse status and fresh fusion output condition were not assigned complete numeric rules in the source table.
runtime_supplements.decision: Dropped equipment is initially unidentified and independently has a1% curse chance. A successful fusion creates one fully repaired, identified, uncursed result at the same canonical equipment ID and next+N; both inputs are consumed. These are condition/status choices, not extra equipment tiers or alternate fusion identities. Neither the1% value nor cleansing-on-fusion is claimed as an official Classic rule.

runtime_supplements.reason: The rooted Mother Tree body needs ground collision matching its authored solid root flare.
runtime_supplements.decision: Five measured root-core tile centers and three polygon-crossing movement edges behind the unchanged service tile64,76 are nonwalkable. Thin decorative roots and the canopy do not block movement. Layout revision6 archives prior saves and moves only positions newly inside solid cells to nearby floor; no resources, elapsed time or progression are changed. This is measured original art geometry, not an official tile-map reconstruction.

runtime_supplements.reason: The owner needs to distinguish the existing active invisibility state during movement.
runtime_supplements.decision: Only the player body renders at38% opacity while its canonical invisibility effect is active; the normal body returns when the effect has not started, expires or breaks. Names, hit geometry, monster detection, collision and engine timing are unchanged. This opacity is original presentation tuning, not an official Classic measurement.

runtime_supplements.reason: The approved minimap UI needs a concrete map view using the independently authored navigable geometry.
runtime_supplements.decision: The existing travel dialog includes a static isometric diagram of the current map, with actual floor/solid cells, measured blocked movement-edge marks, player position and canonical service/entrance markers. It shows no live enemies, loot or pets, adds no travel commands and does not claim to reproduce an official atlas. All marker coordinates use the same runtime geometry as movement.

runtime_supplements.reason: The approved production baseline requires original creature, material, ambience, music, UI and effect audio. No original Classic audio is licensed or copied.
runtime_supplements.decision: 128 explicitly composed/synthesized masters produce256 Opus/AAC deliveries. Creature-family formants, material impacts, sixteen60-second environmental loops and five90-second instrumental arrangements are original interpretations. Event cues use actual outcomes; attack vocalizations use accepted attack events. Canonical biome families select ambience and broad footstep materials; wood/metal step originals are available but await explicit world surface bindings. Long tracks stream; short buffers use8MiB cache,12 voices and4 decode slots, with delayed cues dropped after300ms. Audio begins only through a user gesture and pauses when hidden. Subjective listening, native compressed-loop playback and mobile behavior remain unverified. The complete music/effects mix passes through a bounded soft limiter to leave headroom when voices overlap.

runtime_supplements.reason: Reviewed weapon clips have authored windup and strike/release phases; immediate damage particles appeared before the visible contact.
runtime_supplements.decision: Authoritative combat remains immediate and unchanged. Presentation metadata groups each accepted attack, allowing floating damage, impact FX/sounds and target hit/death reactions to wait for the reviewed contact frame. Four default classes have32 direction markers; Knight N4, Mage S3/N3 and Dark Elf S3/N3 are explicit low-confidence art-direction estimates. Bow release uses its marker followed by the existing250ms flight; wolf contact uses the approved125ms midpoint. Twenty-one additional stance sets use141 independently observed heading markers plus27 explicitly labelled low-confidence authored estimates, preserving the original null observations and per-heading rationale. Unmeasured headings retain immediate presentation rather than borrowing a wrong class marker. Queues hold at most96 events and650ms, suppress duplicate groups, clear on map/resume gaps and never execute damage. Movement may interrupt an attack pose while already confirmed outcomes still present once; dead actors are not forced to replay an attack. Main HUD/stat values stay authoritative. Kill events carry exact newly created ground-item IDs; only those loot labels wait for their own delayed kill contact, without changing logical drop creation or pickup. Thirty-nine nonclass bodies have224 independently observed ordinary-attack windows;88 ambiguous headings remain unset. Pet/form body reuse uses the exact shared manifest. Wolf leap retains its separate125ms midpoint.

runtime_supplements.reason: A foreground roof can hide the living player completely while the player stands on valid exterior floor.
runtime_supplements.decision: Only a closed foreground structure covering at least six of nine opaque torso samples triggers a local feathered visibility ellipse around the living exterior player. Its core retains25% source opacity, smoothly approached over120ms; the remaining structure remains opaque. Exit/death restores opacity. This changes no depth order, position, collision, targeting or gameplay state; pets, enemies and NPCs never trigger it.

runtime_supplements.reason: Initial landmark views lacked deliberate regional props and coherent courtyard/boundary dressing.
runtime_supplements.decision: Eleven named maps use244 authored placements,46 material features and one original dragon-fossil sprite, all tied to existing solid footprints or nonblocking ground materials. Existing world topology, service IDs, collision and routes remain unchanged. The other90 maps and broad route-cleared centers remain explicit world-fidelity work; this is not verified official map geometry.

runtime_supplements.reason: Authoritative dead summons leave the simulation immediately, which otherwise skips their authored collapse animation.
runtime_supplements.decision: A minimal presentation-only snapshot lets at most32 departed summons complete their death pose for at most3150ms, including pending contact delay. It is not stored in the save, cannot be selected or resurrected, and clears on map/import/background reset. Ordinary release and expiry do not create a death body. Authoritative removal, resources, combat and RNG stay unchanged.
